solutions.title: Sorted-character key
solutions.strategy: Sort every word's characters and use that normalized spelling as the hash-map key.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each of the n words sorts at most k characters.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output groups and normalized keys store characters from the input.

solutions.title: Character-count vector key
solutions.strategy: Count each letter and serialize the fixed-size count vector as the hash-map key.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each word is scanned once and a fixed alphabet of a letters is encoded.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output stores grouped words and the map stores one fixed-size key per group.
